core_meaning.primary_meaning: Safet is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Purity, choicest part”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Safet corresponds to the Arabic form صَفْوَت (Arabic root ص ف و (ṣ-f-w); صَفْوَة (Ṣafwa)). Its core sense is safet; purity, choicest part (balkan form). Safet is the Bosnian form of Arabic صَفْوَة (Ṣafwa), meaning 'purity, choicest part'.
